```artifact
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import Prescription, Chemist, Lab, Admin, Patient

class TestPrescriptionFlow(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_prescription_received_by_patient(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        patient = Patient()
        # Act
        patient.receive_prescription(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'received')

    def test_prescription_received_by_nearest_local_chemist(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        chemist = Chemist()
        # Act
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'received')

    def test_prescription_received_by_nearest_local_lab(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        lab = Lab()
        # Act
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'received')

    def test_chemist_provides_medicines_via_offline_delivery(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        chemist = Chemist()
        # Act
        chemist.provide_medicines(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'delivered')

    def test_lab_collects_specimen_and_delivers_lab_reports(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        lab = Lab()
        # Act
        lab.collect_specimen(prescription)
        lab.deliver_lab_reports(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'reported')

    def test_admin_populates_speciality_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        # Act
        admin.populate_speciality_database()
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.speciality_database, 'populated')

    def test_admin_links_specialities_to_doctors(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        # Act
        admin.link_specialities_to_doctors()
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctor_database, 'linked')

    def test_admin_populates_doctor_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        # Act
        admin.populate_doctor_database()
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctor_database, 'populated')

    def test_admin_populates_lab_and_chemist_databases(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        # Act
        admin.populate_lab_and_chemist_databases()
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(admin.lab_database, 'populated')
        self.assertEqual(admin.chemist_database, 'populated')

    def test_patient_registers_into_system(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient()
        # Act
        patient.register()
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(patient.status, 'registered')

    def test_chemist_and_lab_only_see_needed_info(self):
        # Arrange
        prescription = Prescription()
        chemist = Chemist()
        lab = Lab()
        # Act
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)
        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(prescription.status, 'received')
        self.assertEqual(chemist.needed_info, 'protected')
        self.assertEqual(lab.needed_info, 'protected')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
